contrastMethod: Actual visible HTML text and real field/action boundaries use computed sRGB colors composited through ancestor backgrounds. Thresholds use raw unrounded ratios; recorded display values round to three decimals. Normal text 4.5:1, large text 3:1; necessary field boundaries against fill and parent 3:1; action boundary or fill against parent 3:1; actual keyboard outline against adjacent parent 3:1. Unsupported readable compositing fails. Native checkbox internals and forced-color native pixels receive bounded visual inspection.

limits: Chromium only; no screen reader, physical device, other engine, native browser zoom/text enlargement, user study or performance benchmark.

Fifteen extracted variables retain palette/font/geometry provenance. Named font binaries, complete source layouts, density, imagery and components are not reproduced. Removing source depth/material can change identity despite retained radii.
Computed contrast excludes hidden/placeholder text, native popup/validation UI, checkbox glyph internals, antialiasing and browser decorations. Every visible HTML text node is included.
Four fictional tasks are static HTML. Completion, additions, form drafts, filters and preferences live only in this page; reload resets everything. No account, backend, durable save or export exists.
